items.title: Hodgkinson has to settle for silver as Werro wins 800m gold
items.description: Keely Hodgkinson came up just short of a coveted European 800m title hat-trick after Swiss favourite Audrey Werro won their hotly-anticipated showdown in Birmingham as the British Olympic champion settled for silver.
